def generate_sums(index, sum_value, max_exp):
    if index > max_exp:
        sum_set.add(sum_value)
        return
    generate_sums(index + 1, sum_value + pow(base_val, index), max_exp)
    generate_sums(index + 1, sum_value, max_exp)

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    base_input = int(input_data[0])
    target_input = int(input_data[1])

            break
    
    print("YES" if answer else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
